note: Built from the official trophy descriptions alone: the order below follows the story chapters first, then side strands, then collectibles and activities, then cleanup. Nothing here has been checked in the game yet.

stages.goal: Finish the story and earn every chapter, mission and finale trophy while doing the one-time moments as they appear.
stages.step: Keep an eye out for the mystery moment and the second-try trophy — both come naturally if you keep playing.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first

stages.goal: Clear every contact strand and stranger chain, and finish the crime trophies that need a partner or a gang target.
stages.step: With your partner: lose a 4-star wanted level together, and rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Side strands and partners

stages.goal: Sweep the map: every area, every meditation spot, every card set and every WAiNK It location.
stages.step: Complete 3 collectible card sets and discover 100 different vehicles.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles and exploring

stages.goal: Sample every activity, win the races, and grind the counted challenges.
stages.step: Bowl at Kolt & Associates, land the melee drive-by, and take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Activities and challenges

stages.goal: Convert your earnings, buy the properties, and let the platinum pop.
stages.step: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, then check the ledger: the platinum unlocks with the last trophy.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Money and the platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum
